detections.description: Just an EICAR test file - this is boring but users asked for it
detections.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)

yara_ai_explainer:
Summary: The matched file is an EICAR test file, which is a harmless standard file used to test the proper functioning of antivirus software. It contains no actual malicious payload or functionality and is designed solely for detection purposes.
Threat: Test File (Severity: low)
Capabilities:
  - Antivirus software testing
  - Harmless detection trigger
Recommended Actions:
  - Verify that antivirus software is correctly detecting the EICAR test file
  - No further action is required as the file is benign and serves only as a test
  - Ensure security awareness training covers EICAR files if encountered by users to prevent unnecessary alarm
